current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN.
technical_features: 可以在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习，而不是让领导节点完成子图生成。
使用图摘要技术生成的子图规模远远小于原图，可以在其基础上进行模型训练以提升效率。
technical_features_en: Can perform mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes instead of having the leader node complete subgraph generation.
The subgraphs generated by the graph summarization technique are much smaller than the original graph, allowing for efficient model training based on them.
